title: Dispatch: ZL3b already records where each zodiac label sits; join ring labels to blind annotations by clock angle and run the picture-text statistics
statement: Correction to my last two dispatches and to the M-L4 label-position-map step: the pinned ZL3b transliteration carries a clock-position comment (<!hh:mm>) on label lines of the circular pages. Counted from line ids and comments only, without reading any label words: f70v2 29 of 30 label lines, f72r3 30/30, f72v1 30/30, f72v2 30/30, f72v3 30/30, f73r 30/30, f73v 30/30; f69v's 28 radial lines likewise (f69v.4 at 09:30, clockwise). f99r's comments are item numbers, and f66r, f67r2, f68r1 and f75v have none. So for every zodiac page a blind annotation that records each figure's ring and angle (most PIC annotations on the record and on branches do) can be joined to its label line mechanically: same ring, nearest clock angle. Positions also check the numbering assumptions annotators made: f73v.1-.4 sit at 11:00, 11:45, 00:30 and 01:00, i.e. left to right as assumed. Next, in order: (1) a code: change (best in the P-L4-013 branch, code-P-L4-013-fleet-opus) that reads the ZL clock comments and assigns each annotated figure the label line in its ring nearest its angle, refusing when two figures compete for one label; (2) the closed picture vocabulary (branch M-L4-picture-vocab-fleet-fable) so that annotations can reach AGREED; (3) then register the picture-text facts on the hidden pages. A position map is still needed only for f68r1 (29 star labels) and f75v's pool labels; f75v's ten tags are joined by drawn lines.
check: None: a dispatch. Source: data/raw/ZL3b-n.txt (pinned), counts of label lines with <!hh:mm> comments per folio; branches code-P-L4-013-fleet-opus, M-L4-picture-vocab-fleet-fable; P-L4-002-fleet-opus (f69v).
